0022600095.text: The Pacers (1-0, 2nd in the Central and 7th in the East) are on a W1 streak as they host the Mavericks (0-1, 1 game back in 5th in the Southwest and 11th in the West), who are on an L1 streak. Indiana is without Johnny Furphy (knee surgery) and T.J. McConnell (hamstring), while Aaron Nesmith (hamstring strain) and Ben Sheppard (knee soreness) are day-to-day and game-time decisions. Dallas is missing Caleb Martin (thumb sprain), Dereck Lively II (foot surgery), Santi Aldama (knee) and Tarik Biberovic (heel), with Jett Howard (calf) also day-to-day and a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, after the Pacers lost both games to Dallas in 2025-26, including a 134-130 loss in Indianapolis on February 22, 2026.
